output_variables.sdd_easy_surfaces:

   ("invalid SDD artifact link", "invalid SDD plan header block"). Pure string edits.
2. Sidecar repos already store bare `plans/`, `beads/`, `research/` — no sdd/ prefix on disk.
3. `sdd_kind_roots()` already falls back to bare `<kind>/` alongside `sdd/<kind>/`, so the
   in_tree dir rename has a compatibility hook that already exists.
4. `src/sase/sdd/` is a self-contained package: 61 modules, 36 exported names (28 SDD-named).
   Package rename + import rewrite is mechanical across 261 importing files.
5. No `sase sdd` CLI subcommand exists — no user-typed command surface to deprecate.
6. SDD is already absent from the CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md glossary; only 3 memory files mention it.
